correctness.rationale: The equilibria give I_i κ_i v/(a_i+v)^2; the triangular stock dynamics have both eigenvalues −(a_i+v). Measuring flow in units of a_1 and dropping a positive common multiplier gives the stated F. Its derivative is positive up to 1 and negative from R onward; inside (1,R) its sign is that of H_R−K. The log derivative of H_R has the sign of −[2v²−(R+1)v+2R], since its denominator and 2(R−1) are positive. The discriminant is R²−14R+1; above its larger zero the roots are in (1,R) (the polynomial is positive at both endpoints and its minimum is negative and interior). The two simple turns give the open odds window by continuity and the endpoint limits ∞ and 0. At either odds boundary a double crossing root has no sign change and the other root gives the sole peak. At the critical separation H_R is still strictly decreasing, with a second-order derivative zero at v_0; at K=H_R(v_0) the first nonconstant local term of F is negative and quartic. For R=20 the endpoints of the window are exactly 2401/54675 and 2187/38416, with 1/19 strictly between. This is an analytic verification of the specified positive-domain classification, not a validation of physical methane dynamics. Inspected the packaged supplement without executing it.
residual_risks: No validation of equal loss rates, fixed production weights, stratum independence, or field applicability.
